thread_title: S. leucophylla pink interior Washington Co, AL
breadcrumb: S. leucophylla pink interior Washington Co, AL

posts.body_html:
Here's a "new discovery" from a large grow out that produced a few select clones. It sometimes takes 4 or 5 years to see these plants at their fullest, and all of them are crammed in community trays, so it's quite possible more standout clones are hidden in the batch!
